newsitem.title: MAURITIUS: MAURITIUS SELLS $6.86 MILLION OF TREASURY BILLS.
newsitem.headline: MAURITIUS SELLS $6.86 MILLION OF TREASURY BILLS.

text.p: The Bank of Mauritius sold all 150 million rupees (6.86 million dollars) worth of treasury bills at its weekly auction, the central bank said on Thursday.
The central bank sold 91-day bills worth 90.0 million rupees at a weighted average yield of 8.06 percent at Thursday's auction compared with 88 million rupees at 8.31 percent last week.
The bank sold 182-day bills worth 50.0 million rupees with an average yield of 8.25 percent, against 25.0 million rupees at 8.49 percent last week.
The bank sold 364-day bills worth 10.0 million rupees at an average yield of 8.52 percent compared with 45.0 million rupees at 8.49 percent last week.
This week's effective bank rate was posted at 8.15 percent per annum from 8.39 percent last week, the bank said. (US $=21.856 Mauritian rupees)
